Whether the back-half-loaded closings ramp lands - FY2026 closings of 28,500-29,000 against 13,988 closed in H1 - without re-opening the incentive load that just fell to 10.4%, since that ramp is what simultaneously delivers the reaffirmed 24.5%-25% FY gross margin AND the 9.5%-9.7% FY SG&A guide off a 10.7% first half. The hinge MOVED this quarter: the old swing (does incentive load recede from 10.9%) was answered YES; the new swing is whether H2 execution converts that into the two reaffirmed full-year guides.
